title: WHEN STRENGTH FEELS SCARCE
Lamentations 3:23 Sunrise Prayer
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: peaceful sunrise over calm misty lake
soft morning light through forest trees
golden dawn sky over quiet mountain valley
gentle sunrise light on calm water
warm morning sun breaking through clouds
early dawn horizon with soft light

scenes.a: You woke up unsure if strength will come.
Yesterday drained every drop of your resolve, leaving your spirit quiet and heavy in this early room.
Yet Scripture speaks softly into your silence: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
Lord, we gather what little we have at this sunrise, holding our tired hearts before Your steady presence.
We do not ask for a whole year of strength right now, only the gentle grace required for this single morning.
Fill the empty spaces with Your patient mercy, and steady our step as the day begins.
Amen. You can rest even when you woke up unsure if strength will come.
